daily_narrative.happened: U.S. stocks were mixed-to-lower, with the Nasdaq down 1.1% and the S&P 500 down 0.3% as investors appeared to rotate away from large-cap tech after recent weak readings in names like ACN, CTSH, GWRE and RNG, while VIX jumped 7.9%. The move appears to reflect a Goldilocks backdrop favoring cyclicals and smaller caps, with Russell 2000 up 0.3%, Industrials/Technology/Financials edging higher, and momentum/value leadership still outpacing growth over the past month.
